Flick: "I spoke with Ferran during the World Cup, but now he's on vacation. He's important to us."

Flick: "I really appreciate working with Marcus Rashford. His situation was not easy and with loans there's always some uncertainty. We will miss him, but we have to accept it. Gordon has arrived, who really wants to play at Barça and is 'on fire'."

Flick: "Adeyemi has a lot of potential to show. There are things that still need to improve, but he has been training with us for a short time and has a lot of quality. It's good to see him on the pitch and I'm sure he can contribute a lot to us."

Flick: "We have a big goal for the season, but it all depends on how we work each day. The most important thing is the effort of the players, the mentality and the dynamics of the group. Above all, there is the team.”
Flick: "We only focus on what we have, on the players I have right now and nothing else. I'm not dreaming."

Flick: "Hamza is very humble and has a good character. He always tries to give his best and has great potential. As a striker you have to appear in those situations within the area and today he was there. That's what I ask of a nine."

Flick: "The most important thing is that the young players have shown their quality and I really appreciate that. It's a pleasure to work with them and see how they respond in this type of game, with this intensity."

Balde: "Barça is my home. I've been at this club for 16 years, all my life. I want to succeed here, my mind is here. I'm from Barcelona, it's my house. What I think about is continuing for many more years, not leaving."

Balde: "João Cancelo? He has excellent offensive qualities. That also helps me. He's older than me, he has more experience than me and that helps me because I have him as an example. I learned a lot at the time from Jordi Alba. It's Barça and there's competition."

Balde: "Adeyemi? He hasn't been here for a long time, but in the little he's been I've talked to him a lot. I think we have a good relationship. You can see a calm boy. I hope he can help us a lot during the season, and I'm sure he will. He's very fast. He's a player I knew for a long time, and I was impressed by how fast he is."
Balde: "We have had two very good seasons with Hansi. At the national level, we have won practically everything in these two years. We want more, to continue in the same line."
Balde: "I'm still a very young player. I'm only 22 years old and I have a lot of room for improvement. I must continue in that line."
Balde: "I don't have pubalgia."
